title: Nine Floors and One Bell
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：apartment　|　正文 333 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 apartment 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1983 my mother took ① an apartment on the ninth floor and said the stairs were the rent. The ② apartment, meaning the four rooms and not the building, was nine paces from door to window; an apartment, she said, is a place you can cross without thinking, and that is the whole of what you are buying. She said the building was nine years older than the street, and the street was older than the map.

The ③ apartment block had nine floors and one bell, and every apartment in it had the same door and the same smell of boiled cabbage, which she said was how you knew it was a city. Their  apartment had one window that looked onto a wall nine feet away; my father said an apartment is measured by what you can see out of it, and by that measure theirs was nine feet. My grandmother said nine feet of wall is a view if you have never had one.

My grandmother kept ④ apartments in her head, the one in 1951 and the one in 1960, and she could walk through each of them in the dark. The ⑤ apartment, meaning the idea and not the rooms, is the only thing in a city that everybody shares and nobody visits; an apartment, my mother said, is a private thing built out of public noise.

They painted the apartment white in 1985, nine tins of it, and the white lasted four months; the ⑥ apartment building, my father said, had been painted in 1961 and never again. By 1987 the ⑦ apartment had become the word they used for everything: the rent, the stairs, the nine floors.

The  apartment I remember best is the one on the ninth floor, which had a bell that never worked and a door that never shut. An ⑧ apartment, my mother said in 1990, is the only place in a city where you are allowed to be unhappy in private, and she said the stairs were worth it.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 公寓（一套住房）
B. n. 公寓（指那几间屋子，与整栋楼相对）
C. 固定搭配：apartment block 公寓楼
D. n. （复数）一套套公寓；多处住所
E. n. 公寓（抽象概念；这种居住形式）
F. n. 公寓（泛指城市里的这种住所）
G. 固定搭配：apartment building 公寓大楼
H. n. 公寓（引申：房租、楼梯等与之相关的一切）

items.q: an apartment on the ninth floor
The apartment, meaning the four rooms
the apartment had become the word
An apartment, my mother said in 1990

answers.why: apartment 意为“公寓（一套住房）”，1983 年母亲在九楼租了一套公寓，说楼梯就是房租。
apartment 指“那几间屋子”，与整栋楼相对，从门到窗只有九步。
apartment block 意为“公寓楼”，那栋公寓楼有九层，只有一个门铃。
apartments 为复数，意为“一套套公寓、多处住所”，祖母脑子里存着 1951 年那套和 1960 年那套。
apartment 为抽象概念，指“公寓这种居住形式”，它是城市里人人共有却无人造访的东西。
apartment building 意为“公寓大楼”，父亲说这栋楼 1961 年刷过一次，之后再没有刷过。
apartment 引申为与公寓相关的一切（房租、楼梯、九层楼），到 1987 年它成了他们指代这一切的词。
apartment 泛指城市里的这种住所，母亲说公寓是城市里唯一允许你私下不快乐的地方。

公寓，指的是这个念头而不是那些房间，是城市里人人共有却无人造访的东西。（apartment）
1990 年母亲说，公寓是城市里唯一允许你私下不快乐的地方。（apartment）
